summary: Pocahontas County, WV Forest Service lookout built 1936 by CCC labor (40 ft, 14x14 cab); last staffed 1970; now a former site, with no source found describing it today.

facts.status_note: Register lists it as a former lookout site, with no removal date or removal field; no source read says whether anything stands today

notes_for_editor: The status is unknown, not gone: the register's former-site listing and the forest-wide razing statement do not say this tower was removed, and no source read gives a removal date or the site's condition. No web search turned up a Sharp Knob trail or site description. The 1947 National Archives photo is credited on the register page and in the Forest Service history, but its image URL was not captured, so no photos entry. The 2016-2017 brief dates are consistent with the register.
